value.message: Amount of data copied from the Task table
Amount of data copied from the Task table

Limits the number of days of historical data for Task and its child tables (e.g. Incident, Problem, Change) for this clone.

Note: Selecting 'Last 90 days' can increase clone time, due to the post-clone deletion process of records older than 90 days.

To reduce clone time, consider excluding large tables altogether. When excluding tables, your target instance will have the same table schema and hierarchy (i.e. empty usable tables) as the source instance.
Learn more about Amount of data copied from the Task table link opens in new tab.

composition.elementLabel: Use the same backup as another clone request Label

value.message: Use the same backup as another clone request

Specifies which backup the clone request will use. Please carefully review the important notes below:
Most recent: clone will use the latest nightly backup, unless an upgrade or a major change to the instance occurred.
On-demand backup: a new backup will begin at your specified clone start time. Your clone will only begin after the backup completes, pushing back the time at which the cloning process can start.
Learn more about backup options link opens in new tab.

Exclude tables specified in Exclusion list
Exclude tables specified in Exclusion list

Excludes all tables listed on the Exclusion list, including child tables. When excluding tables, your target instance will still have the same table schema and hierarchy (i.e. empty usable tables) as the source instance.

Note: ServiceNow out-of-the-box table exclusions will still be excluded and are not affected by this setting.

Disable this setting if you need the data from your excluded tables (full clone). Recommended for upgrade or deployment testing.
Learn more about Exclude tables specified in Exclusion list link opens in new tab.

Prevents the cloning of audit and log records from the source instance. This will create empty but usable audit and log tables on the target instance.

Note: If you exclude audit and log data from your clone, the Activity Stream for records will not match the source instance. This is because the Activity Stream relies on the audit table to generate the history.
Learn more about Exclude audit and log data link opens in new tab.

Prevents the cloning of files (incl. videos, images, documents, zip files) from the sys_attachment table.

Note: ServiceNow out-of-the-box attachments and other system-relevant files (e.g. catalog item images, theming images, icons) are not affected by this setting.
Learn more about Exclude attachment data link opens in new tab.
